#### slo
- commerce.core.core_template availability 99.9 monthly
- commerce.core.core_template p50 53ms p99 313ms
- commerce.core.core_template error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- commerce.core.core_template freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- commerce.core.core_template backlog drain under 15m after incident
- commerce.core.core_template cold start under 900ms on mobile
- commerce.core.core_template data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- commerce.core.core_template dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- commerce.core.core_template paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- commerce.core.core_template dashboards owned by commerce-core
- commerce.core.core_template load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- commerce.core.core_template degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

- commerce.catalog.catalog_account cold start under 900ms on mobile
- commerce.catalog.catalog_account data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m

- commerce.catalog.catalog_account degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes

- commerce.notification.notification_account.create idempotent=header
- commerce.notification.notification_account.create success=201
- commerce.notification.notification_account.create pagination=n/a
- commerce.notification.notification_account.create timeout=5s retries=0

- fk commerce_partner_account.tenant_id -> tenant.id on delete restrict
- fk commerce_partner_account.created_by -> identity_account.id on delete set null
- rls commerce_partner_account using tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant')::uuid
#### states
- transition draft -> pending guard=partner_guard_0 actor=owner
- transition draft -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal draft=no
- transition pending -> active guard=partner_guard_1 actor=admin
- transition pending -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal pending=no
- transition active -> held guard=partner_guard_2 actor=operator
- transition active -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal active=no
- transition held -> review guard=partner_guard_3 actor=analyst
- transition held -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal held=no
- transition review -> settled guard=partner_guard_4 actor=auditor
- transition review -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal review=no
- transition settled -> suspended guard=partner_guard_5 actor=partner
- transition settled -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal settled=no
- transition suspended -> expired guard=partner_guard_6 actor=support
- transition suspended -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal suspended=no
- transition expired -> closed guard=partner_guard_7 actor=member
- transition expired -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal expired=yes
- transition closed -> purged guard=partner_guard_8 actor=guest
- transition closed -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal closed=yes
- transition purged -> draft guard=partner_guard_9 actor=service
- transition purged -> closed guard=force_close actor=owner audit=required
- terminal purged=yes

- inv8 commerce.partner.partner_batch: operator performing archive while pending must leave metadata consistent and audited

- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket availability 99.9 monthly
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket p50 48ms p99 548ms
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket error budget 43m per month, burn alert at 2x
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket freshness lag under 5s for derived reads
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket backlog drain under 15m after incident
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket cold start under 900ms on mobile
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket data loss objective zero, RPO 0 RTO 15m
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket dependency budget: at most 3 synchronous hops
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket paging policy: burn rate only, never raw error count
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket dashboards owned by commerce-sandbox
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket load tested at 3x forecast peak before release
- commerce.sandbox.sandbox_ticket degradation mode: serve cached read, queue writes
